asset_set: Questionnaire Q6 option 1 — Marketing products on social media

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under hands and product box — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle soft halo glow ring around ring-light only
art_style.mood: upbeat creator-economy energy — approachable digital hustle, not a corporate ad agency
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
brand logos on phone or product

accent.name: coral
accent.use: phone case, floating heart icon, jacket cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: warm yellow
secondary.use: product box fill, ring-light glow tint

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.type: soft diffused illustration key light with ring-light glow accent
lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on phone bezel and ring-light rim
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and product box

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: holds smartphone upright at a flattering recording angle
left_hand.grip: loose fingers wrapped around edges, thumb resting on side rail
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: lifts a small product box toward the phone lens
right_hand.grip: fingertip pinch under the box base
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering just below phone screen

pose.gesture_summary: camera-ready product reveal, mid-recording freeze frame
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no visible phone screen reflection of viewer

accessories.placement: left wrist, resting near phone edge

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands films a short product-unboxing clip for social media at a bright creator desk. The left hand holds a smartphone upright at a flattering angle while the right hand lifts a small skincare box toward the lens, ring-light glow reflecting warmly off the screen. Floating flat-icon hearts and a share arrow hover near the phone edge, capturing the thrill of a campaign about to go live.

primary_objects.name: smartphone
primary_objects.detail: coral case, screen shows small product photo thumbnail with a simple heart icon overlay

primary_objects.name: product box
primary_objects.detail: lavender ribbon bow, glossy flat fill

primary_objects.name: ring light
primary_objects.detail: soft halo glow suggestion, no readable brand marks

primary_objects.name: floating engagement icons
primary_objects.detail: one heart shape and one share-arrow shape, simple rounded outlines, no text

subject.environment: sunlit creator desk corner strip across bottom third, small potted succulent at edge, fades to transparent

composition.layout: diagonal reveal line from product box up to phone screen
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: ring light edge only — no wall or desk clutter
composition.thumbnail_readability: phone silhouette + product box shape readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter E, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, corporate agency, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Marketing products on social media". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms with a rolled cropped denim jacket sleeve, one hand holding a coral smartphone upright showing a small product photo and heart icon, the other hand lifting a warm-yellow product box with lavender ribbon toward the phone lens. Soft ring-light glow at the frame edge. Thin gold bangle on the wrist. Small floating heart and share-arrow icons near the phone. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, generous transparent margins. Mood: upbeat, camera-confident creator energy. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size.
